title: Lid Not Locked
fullDescription: Safety lockout - lid arrows not aligned with base detents.

fixSteps.title: Align lid
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate lid until arrows match base markings.

title: Pitcher Not Locked
fullDescription: Base does not detect pitcher lock.

fixSteps.title: Re-seat
fixSteps.instruction: Place pitcher and twist clockwise to lock.

title: Motor Overload
fullDescription: Thermal cutout activated due to thick mixture or jam.

title: Motor Overheating
shortDescription: Repeated long runs caused thermal trip.

fixSteps.title: Rest
fixSteps.instruction: Cool 30 minutes; pulse instead of continuous.

fixSteps.title: Lock all
fixSteps.instruction: Verify lid arrows and pitcher locked.

title: Blade Jam
fullDescription: Foreign object or thick mix prevents rotation.

fixSteps.title: Clear
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, remove pitcher, clear blades manually.

title: Clean Mode Active
fullDescription: Self-clean cycle running; not an error.

faq.a: Yes, drop dish soap with water.
